annotations.title: Judge one page URL against its site's robots.txt for each AI crawler

description: Judges one page URL against its site's robots.txt for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and CCBot: allowed or not, with the deciding line. US$0.002 per call; POST url. 10 free calls a day per IP, resetting at midnight UTC. Costs US$0.002 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it uses the free trial (10 calls a day per address), then returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/llms.txt

url.description: The http(s) page URL to judge (max 2,048 characters). Only its site's /robots.txt is read; the page is not fetched.

name: attestpage_access_check

crawlers.description: One verdict per crawler: crawler, allowed, user_agent (the lowercase User-agent token used, * when only the wildcard group applies, null when no group applies), deciding_line ({ line, text } of the winning rule, null when no rule matches).

network.description: The payment network (CAIP-2 id); null on trial calls.

rail.description: The payment rail (x402); null on trial calls.

robots.description: The robots.txt that was read: url, http_status, served (true for a 2xx) and truncated (true when the file was longer than the 500 KB this check parses, so only its start was judged). A robots.txt that cannot be read (timeout, DNS or connect error, redirect loop) is refused with 502 robots_unreachable, uncharged.
